title: Dusk, the Puppeteer - Location, Tactics & Rewards
description: Dusk, the Puppeteer in Phantom Blade Zero - where the fight happens, what it drops, and how its attack patterns are countered, including the red and blue flash tells.
keyword: Dusk, the Puppeteer phantom blade zero boss

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Dusk, the Puppeteer is an optional encounter in Village of Lu, found at Unlocked through Memory Flowers.

sections.title: Where to Find the Dusk, the Puppeteer
sections.content:
Location: Unlocked through Memory Flowers.

Appears in: Village of Lu.

sections.title: Weaknesses and Counters
sections.content:
There is no weakness table for this fight because there is no damage-type system to fill one in: nothing here resists, absorbs or is immune to anything, and a chart that says otherwise has been inferred from how the boss looks. Read the fight by attack colour instead - red must be dodged, blue must be deflected, purple means it has just parried you and a counter is already coming. The full explanation is on the combat system.

It is optional, which is why it can be left until the Sha-Chi pool and the Phantom Edge roster are deeper.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.content: No drop is recorded for this encounter in the sources checked, so none is listed. That is a gap in the record rather than a statement that it drops nothing.

sections.title: How to Beat the Dusk, the Puppeteer
sections.content:
What works

  • The encounter only opens through the Memory Flowers, so it is easy to walk past.
  • Manage the summons first - they will interrupt every opening otherwise.

sections.title: Status
sections.content: No. 20 of 60 in the progression order, in Village of Lu. Before it: Yuzan, the Musician Puppet (三号乐偶师 玉瓒). After it: Mu Xiaokui, Young Mistress of the Order (沐小葵). The roster by region is on the boss list, and the fights that can be lost by leaving a region early are on the order page. Location and drops come from the shipped game; patch 1.0302256 is the most recent change to any boss behaviour and it touched only Hua.
